events_timeline.description: The plague sweeps through Thornwood, whose people have never known it.
In Thornwood, Sovereign Anchora founds the Seekers of Thornwood: 8 of 23 people there want freedom to worship in the Faith of Kethani Empire (Reformed)
the Seekers of Thornwood spreads to Sapphire Coast (2 members)
The death of Sovereign Anchora makes a martyr for the Seekers of Thornwood
the Seekers of Thornwood fades away
The pox breaks out in Amber Valley.
In Amber Valley, the discontented found the Reformers of Amber Valley: 17 of 46 people there want freedom to worship in the Faith of Kethani Empire
the Reformers of Amber Valley spreads to Mistwood (2 members)
the Reformers of Amber Valley, 7 strong (15% of the people of Dorrathi Clans), demands the reform of the Faith of Thornwall Confederacy
Dorrathi Clans suppresses the Reformers of Amber Valley in Amber Valley; 1 dies a martyr's death
The pox breaks out in Amber Valley.
Dorrathi Clans persecutes religious minorities in Amber Valley (intensity=0.64)
the Reformers of Amber Valley spreads to Iron Peaks (2 members)
In Amber Valley, the discontented found the Commons of Amber Valley: 7 of 26 people there want relief from hunger and dues
the Commons of Amber Valley, 5 strong (16% of the people of Dorrathi Clans), demands relief from hunger and dues
Dorrathi Clans grants the Commons of Amber Valley relief: remitted dues and grain from the stores (14 from the treasury); poor relief becomes law under Commons Management
the Reformers of Amber Valley fades away
the Commons of Amber Valley disbands, its demand met
In Amber Valley, the discontented found the Penitents of Amber Valley: 9 of 45 people there want the reform of the Faith of Kethani Empire
the Penitents of Amber Valley spreads to Mistwood (2 members)
the Penitents of Amber Valley spreads to Sapphire Coast (2 members)
The marsh fever breaks out in Thornwood.
In Thornwood, the discontented found the Sons of Thornwood: 7 of 19 people there want that Thornwood keep its own customs and officers
the Penitents of Amber Valley fades away
The marsh fever breaks out in Mistwood.
Warchief Halberd of Dorrathi Clans repeals the poor relief
In Mistwood, the discontented found the Commons of Mistwood: 13 of 28 people there want the restoration of the poor relief
the Commons of Mistwood spreads to Sapphire Coast (2 members)
the Sons of Thornwood spreads to Sapphire Coast (2 members)
the Commons of Mistwood spreads to Amber Valley (2 members)
the Commons of Mistwood, 7 strong (11% of the people of Dorrathi Clans), demands the restoration of the poor relief
Dorrathi Clans grants the Commons of Mistwood relief: remitted dues and grain from the stores (12 from the treasury); the poor relief is restored under Commons Management
In Amber Valley, the discontented found the Reformers of Amber Valley (153): 9 of 36 people there want the reform of the Faith of Kethani Empire
the Reformers of Amber Valley (153) spreads to Sapphire Coast (2 members)
the Reformers of Amber Valley (153) spreads to Mistwood (3 members)
the Reformers of Amber Valley (153), 8 strong (15% of the people of Dorrathi Clans), demands freedom to worship in the Faith of Dorrathi Clans
Dorrathi Clans refuses the Reformers of Amber Valley (153)
the Sons of Thornwood fades away
Elder Pikemond rises to lead the Reformers of Amber Valley (153) in Mistwood

the Reformers of Amber Valley (153) breaks away from the Faith of Dorrathi Clans in Mistwood: 'Faith of Dorrathi Clans (Reformed)' is founded in place of the vanished 'Faith of Dorrathi Clans (Reformed)'
the Reformers of Amber Valley (153) becomes the church of 'Faith of Dorrathi Clans (Reformed)'
the Commons of Mistwood disbands, its demand met
King Ballistara of Dorrathi Clans repeals the poor relief
The marsh fever breaks out in Amber Valley.
Dorrathi Clans persecutes religious minorities in Amber Valley (intensity=0.94)
In Amber Valley, the discontented found the Brethren of the Last Days: 8 of 30 people there want freedom to worship in the Faith of Thornwall Confederacy
the Brethren of the Last Days spreads to Mistwood (2 members)
the Brethren of the Last Days, 6 strong (10% of the people of Dorrathi Clans), demands freedom to worship in the Faith of Thornwall Confederacy
Dorrathi Clans refuses the Brethren of the Last Days
The pox breaks out in Sapphire Coast.
The pox breaks out in Amber Valley.
In Amber Valley, Emperor Halberd founds the Commons of Amber Valley (215): 7 of 16 people there want the restoration of the poor relief
The death of Emperor Halberd makes a martyr for the Commons of Amber Valley (215)
the Brethren of the Last Days fades away
In Sapphire Coast, the discontented found the Seekers of Sapphire Coast: 15 of 45 people there want the reform of the Faith of Thornwall Confederacy
the Commons of Amber Valley (215), 5 strong (12% of the people of Dorrathi Clans), demands the restoration of the poor relief
Dorrathi Clans grants the Commons of Amber Valley (215) relief: remitted dues and grain from the stores (12 from the treasury); the poor relief is restored
The poor relief of Dorrathi Clans lapses
the Commons of Amber Valley (215) dissolves: the realm it opposed is gone
the Seekers of Sapphire Coast spreads to Thornwood (2 members)
the Seekers of Sapphire Coast, 12 strong (11% of the people of Kethani Empire), demands the reform of the Faith of Kethani Empire
Kethani Empire tolerates the Seekers of Sapphire Coast and its worship; the Faith of Kethani Empire is tolerated in the realm and the Holy Inquisition is abolished
the Seekers of Sapphire Coast spreads to Mistwood (2 members)
the Seekers of Sapphire Coast disbands, its demand met
The marsh fever breaks out in Amber Valley.
In Amber Valley, the discontented found the Commons of Amber Valley (330): 6 of 19 people there want relief from hunger and dues
Kethani Empire persecutes religious minorities in Thornwood (intensity=0.59)
the Commons of Amber Valley (330) fades away
The marsh fever breaks out in Thornwood.
Queen Caelwen of Kethani Empire repeals the toleration of the Faith of Kethani Empire
In Thornwood, the discontented found the Seekers of Thornwood (343): 8 of 27 people there want the reform of the Faith of Thornwall Confederacy
the Seekers of Thornwood (343) spreads to Sapphire Coast (3 members)
the Seekers of Thornwood (343) fades away
